pages.text: $(bold)Silk$()$(br)Reeled from silkworm cocoons, it serves both as repair material and as cloth. Hold right-click briefly to spend 1 silk and randomly repair about a tenth of one damaged armour piece.
$(bold)Sewing Machine$()$(br)Place it, then right-click a blank silk garment to set it on the table; right-click again to open the interface and start tailoring.
$(bold)Four Blank Silks$()$(br)Hat, tunic, leggings and boots - defence 0, each a canvas free for your brush.
$(bold)The Canvas$()$(br)Paint on the unrolled armour canvas, or switch to voxel mode and stack cubes one cell at a time. Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, right-click to reach hidden faces.

$(bold)Dressing$()$(br)Fit a real piece of armour onto the silk and its enchantments, attributes and durability transfer over; undress it any time to take it back. When durability runs out the silk is not destroyed - it only sheds the dressing and returns to a blank canvas.
